6701ebd79976939e.prompt:
You operate a phone app for a person. You see the screen as text: one line per component,
items indented. Text in quotes is content. Each action is in square brackets and starts with its
address: [l1/r2/trail toggle:off] means address l1/r2/trail, action toggle. Copy the address
exactly. The action is the word only (press, toggle, check), never the → or : part.

screen home
g1 Gallery
  r1 photo:plants · "Fern" [g1/r1 press→fern]
  r2 photo:plants · "Monstera" [g1/r2 press→monstera]
  r3 photo:plants · "Basil"
  r4 photo:plants · "Aloe"

Task: Open the Fern picture
Reply with only JSON: {"address": "<address>", "action": "<action>"}

cb7fe1f4076d62ef.prompt:
You write one UI component of a phone app as a single JSON line.
Use only the listed props. Respect every limit (≤N is a maximum length, [a..b] an item count).
Gallery: Browse several pictures together, optionally opening one.
props: { style?: grid|strip="grid", photos: [2..6 { photo: id, caption?: text≤24, goto?: id }] }
example: {"c":"Gallery","style":"grid","photos":[{"photo":"lib:plants","caption":"Fern","goto":"fern"},{"photo":"lib:plants","caption":"Monstera","goto":"monstera"},{"photo":"lib:plants","caption":"Basil"},{"photo":"lib:plants","caption":"Aloe"}]}

Brief: Show four plant shots together, captioned Fern, Monstera, Basil and Aloe, opening fern from Fern
Reply with only the JSON line, starting with {"c":"Gallery".

d117b9381a4adf82.prompt:
You choose the one UI component that best fits a need on a phone app screen.
Components:
- Actions: Two to four shortcuts to different things the person can do next. Pick: Two to four quick tasks or destinations together. Not one main action (Button) or several records to scan and open (List).
- Banner: Something important to notice now, with an optional link to act. Pick: An immediate warning or status update that stands out at the top. Not a supporting sentence (Note) or the screen's main statement (Hero).
- Button: One main thing the person does next. Pick: One labelled action to press. Not two to four shortcuts (Actions) or a tappable summary of one thing (Card).
- Card: One thing with a little detail, optionally tappable to open it. Pick: A compact preview of one thing, with a title and short detail, optionally opening it. Not several separate things to scan (List) or the screen's main headline (Hero).
- Checklist: Things to do, with each job ticked off when done. Pick: Tick off independent jobs. Not browsing and opening things (List) or following an ordered sequence (Steps).
- Empty: A calm message on a screen that has no content yet. Pick: A screen with nothing yet, explaining the absence of content. Not a main message about existing content (Hero) or a supporting sentence (Note).
- Gallery: Browse several pictures together, optionally opening one. Pick: Several pictures to browse together, in a grid or sideways strip. Not one picture on its own (Photo) or text-led rows of separate things (List).
- Header: Name the screen and offer one optional shortcut. Pick: The title at the top of a screen. Not a label above a group (SectionTitle) or the screen's main message (Hero).
- Hero: The one headline fact or message this screen says. Pick: One main message, photo-led introduction or headline number. Not a supporting sentence (Note) or several numbers (Stats).
- KeyValue: Label and value details of one single thing, like its room or schedule. Pick: Any need about one thing's details or settings. Not several separate things (List) or summary numbers (Stats).
- List: Several things of the same kind, each one tappable. Pick: Several separate things to scan or open. Not the details of one thing (KeyValue) or jobs to tick off (Checklist).
- Note: One short sentence of supporting information. Pick: Add a short supporting sentence. Not something to notice now (Banner) or the screen's main statement (Hero).
- Photo: Show one picture, with an optional caption. Pick: One picture on its own, optionally captioned. Not several pictures (Gallery) or a photo-led main message with a headline (Hero).
- Profile: Identify the person, pet or plant whose screen this is. Pick: An identity block with a name, short detail and optional portrait. Not a screen title or navigation (Header), or a summary to open another thing (Card).
- SectionTitle: Label a group of content and offer one optional link to more. Pick: A short label just above a group within a screen. Not the screen's title at the top (Header) or its main message (Hero).
- Stats: Two to four summary numbers to compare at a glance. Pick: Several totals, counts or amounts together. Not the details of one record (KeyValue) or one headline number (Hero).
- Success: Know an action worked, with its result and the saved item's details. Pick: A standalone moment after an action worked, with a result title and optional detail. Not an ongoing status or urgent warning at the top (Banner), or a screen with no content yet (Empty).

Need, in the person's words: "Show four shots of my plants together with their names underneath"
Reply with only the component id, nothing else.
